text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Shinko Windy—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Look, that's it! It's a "Paka Petit"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Shinko Windy pointed, I saw 
a claw machine filled with plushies styled 
after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Taking a Paka Petit out on trips and 
posting photos on Umatter is all the rage!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
With a Paka Petit, you're guaranteed to 
get attention! We'll get tons of UmaLikes 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Paka Petit!! Windy-chan is 
gonna win ya!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aaah!? My allowance for this 
month is in serious trouble, isn't it~?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Guuuugh... But I really wanted a Paka 
Petit...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Really!? Yay! Then I'm counting on you!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on, grab whichever one you want! 
Windy-chan is cheering you on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
